title: Uniform hitting-time bound
statement: Let $G$ be a finite regular multigraph of positive degree $D$, and suppose $D\le 2|V|$. If $t$ is reachable from $s$ by a finite sequence of adjacency steps, then for every natural number $N$ the cumulative miss probability for hitting $t$ from $s$ through step $N-1$ is at most $10|V|^4$.
hypotheses_covered: A regular multigraph of positive degree $D$
A finite sequence of adjacency steps from $s$ to $t$
